notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level); model-authored and unreviewed, so nothing here ran on a robot. One gate warning stays: G4.REF_VALUE on the joint_positions limit, because the clone states the head travel in degrees (pycozmo/robot.py:33-36) and the lift travel as heights in millimetres (pycozmo/robot.py:38-41), while cap.motion.joint_position.v1 requires radians; the driver converts both exactly (degrees to radians, and a lift height to the arm angle asin((height - pivot) / arm length) with the arm 66.0 mm long and the pivot 45.0 mm high, pycozmo/robot.py:43-51). The cited line therefore holds the bound in another unit, not a different number. The package covers one entry symbol of the card, pycozmo.client:Client: six reads (head_angle, lift_height, lift_angle, battery_voltage, is_picked_up, is_moving) and the cap.motion.joint_position.v1 action over the two joints (joint 1 the head, joint 2 the lift arm), with the native stop Client.stop_all_motors as the e-stop. NOT COVERED: the other entry symbols of the card (pycozmo.conn:Connection, pycozmo.brain:Brain, pycozmo.procedural_face:ProceduralLid, pycozmo.util:Matrix44) are the transport, the off-board personality engine and geometry helpers, not the device interface; one package per repository is the rule. NOT COVERED: the wheel motors (drive_wheels/stop_all_motors exist but wheel speeds are not exposed), the backpack and head lights, the OLED display, the speaker, the camera stream, the animations, the procedural face, the behaviours and the IR LED. The client is asynchronous: set_head_angle and set_lift_height send one packet each and the reported state follows from RobotState messages, so the joint action waits at most 2 s for the reported positions to reach the targets and then reports reached=false rather than blocking; the fake applies a command at once. The hardware backend (native.py, the Wi-Fi connection to 172.31.1.1:5551) was never run, and the fake is an in-memory client, not a recording of a robot. gate.digest is the digest line the last check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-29; reviewed_by stays null): accepted after reviewer edits: the joint bound of cap.motion.joint_position.v1 is now Limit.operator_required, because the lift's arm angle is derived from the 32 to 92 mm heights and shown on no line of the clone (G4 warned); site-limits.example.json carries the converted head and lift ranges, and test_driver.py loads it and checks the refusal without it. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.
